query_analysis.original_query: We are looking to develop a more energy-efficient approach to extract ethanol from a 95% azeotropic mixture. Any suggestions on alternative distillation or hybrid methods?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and propose energy-efficient separation techniques, including alternative distillation or hybrid methods, for extracting ethanol from a 95% azeotropic mixture.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative process design and energy optimization

clarification_questions: What is the desired purity of the extracted ethanol?
Are there any specific constraints on the type of separation methods that can be used?
